acceptance.given: When recording repair evidence and prior repair evidence exists, append a new evidence record using the repository's append-only evidence writer.

oracle.expected: The resulting evidence artifact contains all prior records in original order followed by the new record; comparison confirms no prior record was overwritten or deleted.
forbidden: Any prior repair evidence record is missing, modified, or reordered
Repair evidence is rewritten in place rather than appended
oracle.observable: Append-only evidence artifact plus pre/post record-order comparison is produced during validation.

acceptance.then: The append-only check passes and preservation comparison is recorded.
acceptance.when: A repair-evidence recording operation is executed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the append-only evidence validator against a fixture that attempts overwrite or deletion of an existing repair record; it must fail on mutation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce append-only repair evidence writes while preserving all existing records and rejecting overwrite, deletion, or historical rewrites.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema change; rollback restores prior append-only writer behavior without altering existing evidence artifacts.

slice_hint.state_transition: Existing repair evidence remains immutable; a new record transitions the artifact by append only.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validator proves prior evidence records are unchanged and new evidence is strictly appended.

acceptance.given: During validator evaluation, execute the support-policy validator directly with its own support-policy fixture and inputs.

oracle.expected: Independent evidence explicitly evaluates support policy and records pass/fail for that policy; no result is inferred from another obligation's evidence.
forbidden: Support policy status is inferred solely from another verification
oracle.observable: Validator output contains a support-policy-specific assertion and evidence record tied to the support-policy fixture.

acceptance.then: The support-policy assertion has a standalone passing verification record.
acceptance.when: Validator evaluation is run for support policy.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Invoke the validator with support-policy evaluation disabled or omitted; require failure proving the independent check is mandatory.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or retain a support-policy-specific validator assertion and evidence emission independent of other policy checks.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema change; rollback removes only the independent support-policy assertion wiring.

slice_hint.state_transition: Support policy moves from unverified to independently verified with a dedicated evidence record.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A validator run yields a support-policy-specific assertion result and fails when that assertion is omitted.

acceptance.given: For every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry, execute each route transition applicable to that entry and collect transition results.

oracle.expected: The manifest reconciliation report shows every non-empty entry mapped to all applicable route transitions with 100% completion, including no omitted transitions.
forbidden: Any non-empty entry lacks an applicable transition result
An applicable route transition is omitted
oracle.observable: Bidirectional Consumer Manifest-to-route transition report with per-entry completion status and aggregate 100%.

acceptance.then: All applicable transitions complete for every non-empty manifest entry.
acceptance.when: Applicable route transitions are executed and reconciled against the Consumer Manifest.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove one applicable transition result for a non-empty manifest entry and run reconciliation; require failure identifying the missing transition.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconcile every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry bidirectionally with its applicable route transitions and reject omissions.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema change; rollback restores prior reconciliation logic while retaining manifest compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: Each non-empty manifest entry transitions to completed status for every applicable route transition.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Reconciliation reports zero missing transitions and exactly 100% completion across non-empty entries.

acceptance.given: Execute Matrix Cases for Stable and Candidate subjects using their designated fixtures and isolated execution-state namespaces.

oracle.expected: Evidence records identify Stable and Candidate fixtures separately and show distinct state namespaces or bindings for every execution.
forbidden: Stable and Candidate subjects share a fixture
Stable and Candidate subjects share execution state
oracle.observable: Per-subject execution evidence includes fixture identity and state namespace, with a distinction check passing for both subjects.

acceptance.then: Stable and Candidate executions are demonstrably fixture- and state-distinct.
acceptance.when: Matrix Case executions run for Stable and Candidate subjects.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Configure Stable and Candidate to reference the same fixture or state namespace and run the distinction validator; require failure identifying the collision.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind Stable and Candidate executions to distinct fixtures and isolated state while emitting attributable evidence for each subject.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema change; rollback restores previous subject-binding logic without merging existing state.

slice_hint.state_transition: Stable and Candidate executions transition from unspecified separation to explicitly distinct fixture and state bindings.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Distinctness validator confirms non-equal fixture identities and non-overlapping state namespaces for Stable versus Candidate.
